info.title: Permguard Host API
info.description: The Host listener (WP-2.5): `/host/v1` over TLS on `admin.addr`, and `permguard.host.v1` on the same port, one facade behind both. Every route authorizes with the Host's grants; every mutation carries a request id, may state the revision it expects, and answers a receipt. Identity, membership, evidence and the key and configuration mutations arrive with their packages; this document describes what this build serves.

get.description: Under `identity.read` on the Host. The public identity: the signed document, the succession records, the epoch-1 public key and the protocol versions.

401.description: No usable credential: nobody, or a credential no rule maps. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Mutual-TLS realm="permguard"`.

403.description: A principal without the grant the route requires.

503.description: No Host identity is open (`identity_unavailable`), or the principal is over its bound (`principal_bound_exceeded`).

post.description: Under `identity.admin` on the Host. A security mutation: the next epoch's key is generated, the current key signs the succession, the next signs the document. A retry with the same request id answers the stored receipt.

class.description: Which kind of thing went wrong; fixes the HTTP status: 400, 409, 404, 503, 500.
class.x-grpc-note: gRPC carries the class as the `permguard-error-class` metadata of the status.

code.description: The stable name of the exact condition; the Host API's own codes are owned by 6-contracts/8-contract-host-api.md.
code.x-grpc-note: gRPC carries the code as the `permguard-error-code` metadata of the status.

revision.description: Beside a `conflict`: the current revision, so the caller can read, decide and retry. Absent otherwise.
revision.x-grpc-note: gRPC carries it as the `permguard-revision` metadata of a `FAILED_PRECONDITION` status.

HostWireError.description: A refusal of the Host API: the shared `{class, code, message}`, and the current revision beside a conflict (the common envelope's *errors*).
HostWireError.x-grpc-note: gRPC answers a refusal with a status whose metadata carries `permguard-error-class`, `permguard-error-code` and, beside a conflict, `permguard-revision`; no proto message carries the fields.

grant_id.description: The grant's id: 32 hex characters, permanent.

principal.description: The authorization principal the grant is held by.

selector.description: The resource prefix it covers, optionally ending in `/*`.

constraints.description: Reserved for later packages; empty today.

revision.description: The store revision of the grant's last transition.

status.description: `active`, `revoked` or `expired`; the last two are terminal.

expires_at.description: When it expires, RFC 3339; `null` for a grant without an expiry.

Grant.description: One grant, as the API shows it (every replaceable record carries a revision).

revision.description: The store revision the list was read at.

request_id.description: The caller's name for this mutation, 1 to 128 bytes without control characters; a retry carries the same one and is answered with the stored result.

expected_revision.description: The store revision the caller read; a different current revision is a `conflict` (`revision_mismatch`) carrying it. Optional; `null` is absent.

principal.description: The authorization principal to hold the grant; never `anonymous`.

selector.description: A resource prefix, optionally ending in `/*`.

expires_at.description: When the grant expires, RFC 3339; absent or `null` for no expiry.

CreateGrantBody.description: What `POST /host/v1/grants` carries: the contract's `{principal, operations[], selector, resource_types[], constraints?, expires_at?}` with the envelope's request id and expected revision. A closed body.

trail.description: The audit trail that recorded the event.

seq.description: The event's position in the trail; `null` until the trail numbers its events (WP-3.5).

digest.description: The event's digest; `null` until the trail seals its events (WP-3.7).

AuditReference.description: Where the audit trail recorded a mutation.
AuditReference.x-grpc-note: `seq` and `digest` are present and `null` until the sealed trail produces them (owner decision, 2026-10-06); they are never invented.

operation_id.description: This process's name for the mutation as applied; the same on a replayed answer.

audit.description: Where the audit trail recorded it.

Receipt.description: What every mutation answers: the envelope's `{operation_id, revision, audit}`.

GrantCreated.description: What a create answers: the receipt and the grant, `grant_id` included.

request_id.description: The caller's name for this mutation; a retry is answered with the same plan.

expected_revision.description: The grant revision the caller read; a different one is a `conflict` carrying the current. Optional; `null` is absent.

PlanRevokeBody.x-grpc-note: `grant_id` travels in the path on REST.

plan_digest.description: The plan's digest, SHA-256 hex; the run step presents it back.

expires.description: When the plan can no longer be run, RFC 3339: ten minutes after it was made.

revision.description: The grant revision the plan was made against; the run is a `conflict` when it moved.

GrantRevokePlan.description: What a plan answers: a server-held plan, consumed once by its run. `TODO(WP-3.9)`: the client-held COSE_Sign1 `permguard.operation.plan.v1` receipt.

request_id.description: The caller's name for this mutation; a retry is answered with the stored receipt.

plan_id.description: The plan the plan step answered.

RunRevokeBody.x-grpc-note: `grant_id` travels in the path on REST.

GrantRevoked.description: What a run answers: the receipt and the grant as revoked.

keys.description: How many public keys it publishes.

digest.description: SHA-256 over its public set as published, hex.

kid.description: Which key this is, matching the `kid` a signature names.

kty.description: The key type: `OKP` for the Edwards curves, `EC` for the NIST ones.

crv.description: The curve, when the key type has one.

x.description: The public key itself, base64url without padding.

y.description: The second coordinate, for the key types that have one.

alg.description: The algorithm this key is used with.

use.description: What the key is for; always `sig`.

HostJwk.description: One public key as RFC 7517 defines it, every member present; the private half is never expressed. The same key `common.json#/components/schemas/Jwk` describes, with `null` where that document omits.

epoch.description: The ring epoch; `null` until the ring bindings carry one (WP-2.3).

digest.description: SHA-256 over the public set as published, hex: what a cache compares.

binding.description: The signed binding of this ring to the Host identity; `null` until WP-2.3.

cache_max_age.description: How long a client may cache the set, in seconds; also the `Cache-Control` header.

keys.description: Every key a client may need to verify with.

KeyRing.description: What `GET /host/v1/keys/{ring}` answers: one ring's public set with its digest and cache policy.

capability.description: What is served without its backing.

HostDegraded.description: One capability that is served and cannot currently do its work.

component.description: The component's name: `host`, a plane's id, or a service's name.

state.description: A lifecycle phase for the Host and a plane; `disabled`, `running`, `backoff`, `draining` or `failed` for a service.

stalled_since.description: Since when it cannot progress for a remote reason, RFC 3339; `null` when it can.

last_success.description: A service's last successful run, RFC 3339; `null` when it had none.

next_attempt.description: When a service in backoff tries again, RFC 3339; `null` otherwise.

reason.description: Why it is where it is; `null` when nothing is wrong.

HostComponent.description: One component of the process, every member present: the same component `health.json` lists, with `null` where that document omits.

enforcement.description: Always `local`: the Host enforces its profile, it never attests it.

added_controls.description: Controls of a higher profile the deployment switched on, by their stable names (`7-architecture-security.md#assurance-profiles`).

relaxations.description: Relaxations the values in force amount to, each one the profile permits; nothing relaxes silently.

Assurance.description: The assurance block (WP-2.8): the profile in force, how it is enforced, the higher controls added and the relaxations in force; the same block the process discovery document publishes.

ready.description: Whether the process is ready: the Host and every required Plane in Ready or Serving.

components.description: Every component the process hosts, the Host first.

key.description: The setting's key, as the environment spells it.

value.description: Its value in force, or `********` when the key names a secret; `null` when unset with no default.

origin.description: The layer the value came from; `default` when no layer supplied it and the image default is in force.

class.description: `startup`: varies per instance (binds, volume paths, TLS bootstrap, secret references, instance ids); `static`: one file for every instance (WP-2.9).

Setting.description: One effective setting with the layer it came from, secrets masked.

revision.description: `0`: the static configuration this process started with.

settings.description: Every setting this build reads, supplied or default, secrets masked.

journal.description: The dynamic Host journal: `grants` today; memberships and key actions with their packages.

revision.description: The journal revision the transition produced.

target.description: What the transition is about: a grant id.

ConfigRevision.description: One transition of a dynamic Host journal.

ConfigRevisions.description: What `GET /host/v1/config/revisions` answers: the transitions of the Host's dynamic journals (WP-2.9).

document.description: The signed identity document of the current epoch: COSE_Sign1 `permguard.host.identity.v1`, base64url without padding.

successions.description: Every succession record, oldest first: COSE_Sign1 `permguard.host.succession.v1` each, base64url without padding.

first_public_key.description: The epoch-1 public key, the suite's raw bytes, base64url without padding: what the first fingerprint pins, from which the chain verifies.

protocol_versions.description: The protocol versions this Host speaks.

request_id.description: The envelope's request id: a retry carries the same one.

expected_epoch.description: The epoch the caller read; the rotation produces the next one.

RotateIdentityBody.description: A rotation of the Host identity.

receipt.description: The receipt; its revision is the new epoch.

succession.description: The succession record to the new epoch, COSE_Sign1, base64url without padding.
